asr.full_text: This is Shah, Dogecoin is quietly building one of the cleanest structures in the market right now. But most traders are either too early or too late to recognize what is actually happening. Right now, Dogecoin is trading around 0.091. And in the last update, we clearly marked that major Support sitting around 0.090, and the plan was very simple. As long as that level holds, the direction remains to the upside. Now, what happened next was exactly what Strong Structure looks like. Price respected that support perfectly, held his ground and started pushing higher step by step instead of making random volatile moves. From that support, Doge moved upward and reached the midpoint between the support and resistance, which comes around 0.095 Now, this level is not just a random number. It acts like a reaction zone where price either pauses, or decides whether it has enough strength to continue higher. What makes this move even more important is the way price is climbing we are seeing clean higher highs and higher lows forming which is the foundation of a bullish structure this is where most traders get confused they focus only on price levels but ignore structures structure is what tells you whether a move is sustainable or not right now as long as Doge continues to hold its previous higher low which sits around 0.09085 the structure remains intact and bullish that means dips into that region are not weakness they are simply part of a healthy trend now looking ahead If this structure continues to hold, the natural path for price is to push toward the resistance level markets move from liquidity to liquidity and Once support is respected and structure is built, the next target usually becomes the liquidity resting near resistance. But here is the key part you need to understand! Not every move upward is a straight line. Even in bullish conditions price will retrace, shake out weak hands and test your patience. This is why having a clear plan based on structure is far more powerful than reacting to every small move. Now let me ask you something important. Do you actually trade during the weekend? If you do, what is your strategy? Do you prefer entering directly at strong support levels, or do you wait for confirmation through structure, like higher highs and higher lows before taking a position because that decision alone can completely change your results over time some traders try to catch the exact bottom while others wait for confirmation and sacrifice a small portion of the move for higher probability there's no single right answer, but understanding your approach and sticking to it consistently is what separates disciplined traders from emotional ones. Join shaa.com for free signals and let me know which coin you want me to cover next.
